title: Pristine BiVO4 band structure
action: Perform periodic DFT calculation (PBE, ultrasoft pseudopotentials) for pristine monoclinic BiVO4: optimize geometry, compute band structure along a high-symmetry path, and save the band eigenvalues.
description: Band structure of pristine BiVO4. Used as reference for bandgap reduction.
output_schema: Each line contains five space-separated fields: k_x k_y k_z spin_index eigenvalue (eV). spin_index=0 (non-spin-polarized). Eigenvalues are referenced so that occupied states have eigenvalue ≤ 0, unoccupied > 0. Bands separated by blank lines.

title: Charge-balanced N-doped BiVO4 band structure
action: Perform DFT calculation for BiVO4 with charge-balanced nitrogen doping (approximately 6% N substitution and 3% O vacancy per supercell, e.g., 48-atom cell). Compute band structure and save eigenvalues.
description: Band structure of charge-balanced N-doped BiVO4.
output_schema: Each line contains five space-separated fields: k_x k_y k_z spin_index eigenvalue (eV). spin_index=0 (non-spin-polarized). Eigenvalues are referenced so that occupied states ≤ 0, unoccupied > 0. Bands separated by blank lines.

title: N-doped BiVO4 with excess O vacancies band structure
action: Perform spin-polarized DFT calculation for BiVO4 with 6% N substitution and 6% O vacancies (excess vacancies). Compute spin-polarized band structure and save eigenvalues.
description: Band structure of N-doped BiVO4 with additional oxygen vacancies beyond charge balance (spin-polarized).
output_schema: Each line contains five space-separated fields: k_x k_y k_z spin_index eigenvalue (eV). spin_index=0 for spin-up, 1 for spin-down. Eigenvalues are referenced so that occupied states ≤ 0, unoccupied > 0. Bands separated by blank lines.

title: Dielectric constants (pristine and N-doped)
action: For pristine BiVO4 and charge-balanced N-doped BiVO4 (same composition as step02), compute the high-frequency (ε∞) and static (ε0) dielectric constants using density functional perturbation theory (DFPT) with PBE functional. Average over the three lattice directions and save the values.
description: High-frequency and static dielectric constants for pristine and charge-balanced N-doped BiVO4.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: pristine_epsilon_inf (float), pristine_epsilon_0 (float), N_doped_epsilon_inf (float), N_doped_epsilon_0 (float).

title: Polaron properties and mobility enhancement
action: Using the dielectric constants from step04 and the small polaron model: compute polaron binding energy W_p = e²/(2 ε_p r_p) with ε_p from 1/ε_p = 1/ε∞ - 1/ε0 and r_p obtained from DFT structural data (≈1.73 Å). Compute small polaron hopping activation energy W_H using the formula W_H = e²/(4π ε_p) * (1/r_p - 1/R) where R is the nearest V–V distance from the supercell. Estimate the relative change in electron mobility (μ ∝ exp(-W_H/kT)). Save all quantities.
description: Computed polaron binding energy, hopping activation energies, and mobility enhancement.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: W_p_eV (float), W_H_pristine_eV (float), W_H_doped_eV (float), mobility_enhancement_percent (float).

title: Optical absorption edge shift
action: Using the DFT wavefunctions of pristine and charge-balanced N-doped BiVO4, compute the imaginary part of the dielectric function ε₂ within the random phase approximation (including local field effects), average over the three lattice directions. Determine the absorption onset energy (the energy at which ε₂ begins to rise) for each system and report the redshift.
description: Absorption edge energies and the redshift between pristine and N-doped BiVO4.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: pristine_bandgap_edge_eV (float), N_doped_bandgap_edge_eV (float), redshift_eV (float).
